And it's under realistic load. I didn't stop the validator or anything. same with mine getting essentially the same benches I guess we just need to perform this work with all threads? 😅 Even though it will impact (slow down) other duties. The newer Macs (M4+) are just too fast. These are unrealistic. No one runs validators on these yet. There's barely linux support for M3. like executing the block which is fully parallelized now and happens at the same time? I think it's fine as long as we keep the gas limit very low, and we are certain to have executed the payload by second 8 Maybe (I'm not sure about this), since all the developers who are touching leanVM are working on Mac M4 or Linux with AVX512, we have included too many optimizations targeting those cases and we could maybe check for other optimizations targeting specifically AVX2/parallelisation/memory etc. Not sure about the result and if there are still things to gain here but we could look if this really becomes a big bottleneck. We already have many things that include AVX2, but we could look into it more closely if necessary. what is the hardware (cpu and memory) of your node <@755590043632140352> ? `Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 155H` with 64 GB of RAM there aren't many home nodes better than that one do you know the RAM model ? (STARKs are often memory botlenecked) `Kingston FURY KF556S40-32: 32 GB, DDR5-5600, CL40, dual-rank, running at 5600 MT/s` two of those according to udevadm thanks a lot again, you should consider my node a top of the line node, and it's taking 4 seconds with 4 dedicated cores you wont have more than that if I'm executing a block the bench says that it peaks at 3GB RAM though, so I guess it needs fast memory but not much yeah exactly Yep. The NUC 14 Pro is going to be the upper end of solo-staking hardware.
